title: Gators Swim Club | El Cerrito, CA - Official Website
text: Gators Swim Club | El Cerrito, CA - Official Website Skip to Main Content Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. Website Sign In Facebook Twitter Pinterest Delicious Blogger LinkedIn Home My Account Printer Friendly Email Page Contact Us RSS Site Map Translate Page Notifications Documents Search Adult Youth & Teen Swim Center Events Parks & Facilities Online Registration Contact & Connect Home Your Government City Departments Recreation Swim Center Gators Swim Club Gators Swim Club The El Cerrito Gators is a USA Swimming registered club that has a history spanning over 40 years. We are dedicated to providing a fun and challenging program for children and teens that will enable them to improve their swimming ability and become competitive in the sport. Questions? Please email Gators Head Coaches Keri and Violet at ecgators.swim@gmail.com . Gators 2026-2027 swim season information Parent Meeting TBD Try-Outs Try-outs are every Thursday at 6:15pm , drop-in for a try-out to see if you can become a Gator! At this time all groups require a tryout and some groups may be full. David Hunter Memorial Scholarship The City of El Cerrito offers scholarships for youth to assist families in need. Scholarships up to $300 per child may be granted up to two times per year. Scholarships expire one year from the initial award date. P arents/guardians must pay a co-payment of at least 25% of the program fee for each program that you are registering for. For more information or to apply for the David Hunter Memorial Scholarship, visit David-Hunter-Memorial-Scholarship-Fund . USA Swimming registration All Seniors, Juniors, and Stroke Development swimmers are required to have an active USA Swimming membership. You will be responsible for registering your swimmer with USA Swimming. For an up-to-date registration link, please email the Head Coaches at ecgators.swim@gmail.com . All swimmers registered with USA Swimming are required to complete the free SafeSport training. Gators Information Packet Please read the Gators Information Packet for 2026-2027 Cancelling For swimmers that no longer wish to participate, cancellations are permitted if submitted no less than two weeks prior to the first of the month. ALL cancellations, regardless of when cancelled, result in a $27 cancellation fee. Cancellation/refund requests with less than two weeks’ notice will not be permitted except for medical reasons supported by a doctor’s note. To process your cancellation please email ecgators.swims@gmail.com . All cancellations must be requested via email. Gators Schedule: All practices take place in the Emery G. Weed III Lap Pool Caiman Green: 4:30 - 5:15 p.m. Mon-Thu Caiman Black: 4:30 - 5:15 p.m. Mon-Fri Stroke Development: 5:15 - 6:15 p.m. Mon-Fri Juniors: 5:15 - 6:45 p.m. Mon-Fri Seniors: 5:15 - 7:00 p.m. Mon-Fri Swimmers are encouraged to attend at least 3 days per week in order to promote their development and success as swimmers. Fees for 26/27 season Auto-debited on the 1st of each month Program Resident Non-Resident Caiman Black $95 $118 Stroke Development $126 $158 Juniors $189 $236 Seniors $221 $276 Caiman Swim Team Pricing (26/27 Season) Weekly: 4-Class Session: $22 Resident | $28 Non-Resident 3-Class Session: $17 Resident | $22 Non-Resident NEW! Monthly: Resident: $66-$105 depending on month Non-Resident: $78-$124 depending on month Additional Info 15% sibling discount available. Swimmers in Caiman Black, Stroke Development, Juniors, and Seniors will be billed $13 for a team cap after registration. $27 cancellation fee. SAFE SPORT INFORMATION: Safe sport club coordinator: Keri Pock To deal with a Safe Sport concern, contact USA Swimming at (719) 866-4578. Contact the U.S. Center for Safe Sport to make a report. Call 833-587-7233 or use the online reporting form or find more information at http://www.uscenterforsafesport.org/ Resources Best Practice Guidelines Abuse Prevention Policy Free Trainings: Parents/Guardians (30 Minutes) Kids Ages 5-12 (15 Minutes) Youth Ages 13-17 (20 Minutes) Questions? Please email Head Coaches Keri and Violet at ecgators.swim@gmail.com . Please note: High-Use Facility: This is a high-use facility with multiple programs happening at a time. During your reservation time, other programs may be occurring that have loud music or amplified sound. Verification of Residency: Proof of household address may be requested at any time to verify residency. This may be in the form of a utility bill or rental lease. Caiman Green Group Caiman Black Group Stroke Development Junior Group Senior Group Caiman Green Group Caiman Green Group: For kids with limited swimming experience who are able to swim 25 yards without stopping. This group focuses on solidifying basic swimming skills including breathing, head position, and basics of Freestyle, Breaststroke, and Backstroke. Two options available! Green Group Weekly Session are 4 days long (Monday-Thursday) or 3 days depending on holidays. Green Group Monthly Sessions (by Coach permission only) range from 12-19 days depending on the month and holidays, with practices Monday-Thursday. Caiman Green is currently full, please come for a tryout to get on the waitlist. Caiman Black Group Caiman Black Group: For kids with some experience swimming – able to swim 50 yards of freestyle with side breathing, 25 yards of backstroke, 25 yards of breaststroke with correct kick, and demonstrate proper dolphin kick. This group is focused on developing the fundamental skills required for competitive swimming including drills, turns, and dives. Stroke Development Stroke Development: For swimmers with moderate swimming experience. Swimmers must be able to swim all four competitive strokes with proper techniques and demonstrate the endurance required for a one hour practice. Swimmers in this group start to develop racing strategies and work with intervals to improve their speed and endurance while continuing to build on the fundamentals learned in Caiman Black. Junior Group Junior Group: D esigned for youth with a moderate amount of competitive swimming experience. It is focused on refining technique, improving speed and endurance, and working towards achieving personal goals set by swimmers. This group utilizes longer and more intense practices to help build speed and endurance, and both physically and mentally prepare swimmers for competition at a higher level. As with previous groups this is still designed to be a fun and engaging environment that helps swimmers work on important life skills and educates them in how to maintain and improve their physical and mental well-being. Senior Group Designed for swimmers with a large amount of prior competitive experience. Seniors is focused on increasing the competitive performance of its members. This group is designed to help swimmers achieve their competitive goals and help them reach their full potential as athletes. As with all other groups there is an emphasis on learning how to improve physical and mental health, as well as facilitating personal growth. Character Technique Personal Improvement TeamWork Camaraderie Youth Development Christ Centered. Youth Development. Our Mission Through a Christ-centered approach, Full Armour Swim Team is committed to allowing youth in our community to experience growth and development through the sport of swimming and to strive for personal excellence and improvement. We compete as individuals coming together to form one team entrenched with a sense of teamwork, camaraderie and support for one another. Summer Swim Team Swim Lessons Offered Year Round! So many options to fit your schedule! Swim Lessons Swim Team Join Our Growing Program! 2026-27 Summer Swim Team Join Us Next Summer! Join Us Next Summer Lifeguard & CPR Coming Soon What Makes Us Different Full Armour Swim Team is not your ordinary swim team. We are focused on developing youth in a loving environment. While we strive to be the best swim team that we can, and we are confident that we have some of the most knowledgable coaches implementing the latest in sports physiology and psychology research, we also know that there is much more to be gained by competing on a swim team than just medals and best times. ​ Times and Achievements will fade... but the bonds our kids make with each other and the memories will last a lifetime. In addition, swimmers learn valuable life skills and teamwork! ​ Our job as coaches is simple it is to love our athletes and provide them with the best coaching. If we do that, with God's help, we will achieve what we have set out to achieve... Personal and Team Excellence! ​ We hope you choose our team! title: Kids Swim Lessons | Swimming Classes | Gold Medal Swim School
text: er Surprise LOG IN Swim Lessons Baby Swim Learn To Swim Adult Swim Olympic Development Swim Camp Welcome Packets Swim Teams Swim Teams Swim Team Resources Summer Swim Team Welcome Packet Members Policies and Procedures Udio Login Unlimited Swim Request Cancellation Request Pricing About Us About Us Swim Calendar Our Instructors Contact Us Employment Inquiry Employee Login Locations Chandler Surprise Swim Lessons Baby Swim Learn To Swim Adult Swim Olympic Development Swim Camp Welcome Packets Swim Teams Swim Teams Swim Team Resources Summer Swim Team Welcome Packet Members Policies and Procedures Udio Login Unlimited Swim Request Cancellation Request Pricing About Us About Us Swim Calendar Our Instructors Contact Us Employment Inquiry Employee Login Locations Chandler Surprise Contact Me! Enroll Now! Swim Lessons for Kids & Adults Confident swimmers start here Try a Free Swim Lesson Small Classes • Expert Instructors • Free Unlimited Swim Small Classes Expert Instructors Free Unlimited Swim Swimming Lessons for Every Age & Skill Level Arizona's Top Swimming Schools Gold Medal Swim School helps kids become strong, confident swimmers through expert instruction, small classes and a proven learn-to-swim program. From a child’s first swim lesson to advanced swimming skills, our instructors make learning fun while building proper technique and confidence in the water. Baby & Toddler Swim Lessons 3 – 36 Months A fun, positive introduction to the water that helps little swimmers become comfortable and confident. Learn More! Kids Swim Lessons 2 – 12 Years Step-by-step instruction that builds swimming skills, independence and confidence. Learn More! Adult Swim 13+ Years Developing water survival skills and swimming independence through comfort and swimmer basics. Learn More! Swim Team 5+ Years Take those skills even further with competitive swimming, teamwork and new goals to achieve. Learn More! Take a Free Trial Class Give your child skills they’ll use for life. Gold Medal Swim School combines expert instruction, small classes and plenty of time in the water to help kids become strong, confident swimmers — while having fun along the way. Our proven approach helps children build proper technique, reach new goals and develop confidence with every lesson. Whether they’re just getting started or ready for their next challenge, we’ll help them keep moving forward. TRY A FREE SWIM LESSON Why Parents Choose Gold Medal Swim School You want more than a place where your child spends 30 minutes in a pool. You want to see them learning, progressing and becoming more confident every week. That’s what our swim school is built around. Small Swim Classes More individual attention means more opportunities to learn, practice and improve. Expert In-Water Instructors Our instructors get in the water with students to demonstrate skills, provide hands-on instruction and keep kids engaged. Proven Swimming Techniques Kids learn proper swimming techniques from the beginning, building skills they can continue developing for years. Confidence That Goes Beyond the Pool Swimming gives kids opportunities to tackle challenges, reach goals and experience the pride that comes from mastering something new. Ready to Learn To Swim? Not All Swim Schools Are Created Equal 30-Minute Lesson Each Week Easy-To-Schedule Makeups FREE Unlimited Swim Program Max 4:1 Student-to-Instructor Ratio Water Safety Skills Taught Weekly Free Trial Class Swim Assessment Pricing Contact Me! We Believe All Swim Lessons Are Not the Same Finding swim lessons near you is easy. Finding a swim school that’s the right fit for your child takes a little more thought. Gold Medal Swim School combines small classes, experienced instructors, proven teaching methods and more opportunities to practice. Built on more than 40 years of experience working with world-class and Olympic-level athletes, 20 years of teaching in our community, and our unwavering commitment to doing what is best for kids. Water So Clean, You Could Drink It! Our facility reflects our commitment to safety: More Practice. More Confidence. More Progress. The entirety of the pool water is replaced every six days! Ozone Disinfectant System used for water sanitation (the same system used for bottled water!) Disinfecting systems before and during each shift Professional cleaning services sanitize the entire facility nightly Extensive Instructor Training Trusted and Talented Staff About Our Facility FREE Unlimited Swim More Practice. More Confidence. More Progress. Kids get better at swimming by swimming. That’s why Gold Medal families can take advantage of FREE Unlimited Swim , giving kids more opportunities to practice their skills and become stronger swimmers — without adding another lesson to your bill. More pool time means faster progress and stronger skills Structured lessons with a certified instructor Available for Baby Swim, Learn To Swim , and Adult Swim programs Request an extra class on the same day, when it fits your schedule Learn More! What Are People Saying About Us? From Mike Walker the owner, to each and every staff member I have encountered from the pool to the front desk, 110% effort to do everything possible in the best interest of the children! I had forgotten to get signed up for a Boot Camp that started on Monday morning, on Sunday afternoon I reached out and received a call back (on a Sunday afternoon), they helped me sign up, and less than 18 hours later we were in the water. If you are wondering if this is a good place for your family, rest assured, you and your children, will be treated like gold! Thank you Mike, Nancy, and everyone else at Gold Medal Swim School!!! Glen Daignault Parent I have nothing negative to say about the place. Heather and Kenzie are incredible instructors. I trust them entirely with our kids. I'm even more impressed that I haven't seen an ounce of frustration out of these instructors after seeing kids back-to-back on 30 minute lessons. They welcome the kids into the pool by their names (how do you remember everyone?!), they never break a smile, and they are always moving to teach/instruct with a very personal and professional demeanor. Don't even consider another place. Tarek K Parent This is the only school that was able to teach my whole family, all slow learners, how to swim within 2 months. I was able to swim freestyle, breaststroke, backstroke, and butterfly by the end of my 3rd month. Amazing school and even more amazing teachers! I definitely recommend this school to anyone, who wants to learn swimming, or struggled to learn how to swim in the past. Vi Tu Parent Really liking gold medal with our boys. They seem to have a good program that kids can move up through as they gain greater skills in the water. We love the focus with the little ones on waiting for adults to help them go in the water and being able to turn and grab the side if they fall in! Also love their pool and shower setup that helps allow everyone to shower off at once as classes change each 30/60 min (as a former competitive swimmer). Rick Hanton Parent A Better Way to Teach Kids to Swim We teach respect for the water, not fear. That's how you build a safe swimmer for life! Great swim lessons are about more than getting from one side of the pool to the other. Our approach helps children learn proper swimming techniques from the beginning, build confidence in the water, and develop strong skills they can keep improving for years to come. Tailored for Kids We teach kids proper swimming techniques from the start , building strong skills step by step. Olympic techniques, adapted for kids Strong skills from day one Step-by-step progress that lasts Instructors By Their Side Our instructors are in the water with your child —demonstrating, encouraging hands-on. In-water, hands-on instruction Lessons kids can follow Encouragement every step of the way Confidence That Lasts Kids build more than swimming skills. They develop confidence and a love of the water. Builds comfort and confidence Develops independence in the water Skills that grow with your child FAQs What is Unlimited Swim and how do I request it? Unlimited Swim is a FREE program for all students enrolled in Baby Swim, Learn To Swim, or Adult Swim classes, allowing them to attend one extra class per day based on availability. It’s a great way to add more practice and progress faster — at no additional cost! You can request an Unlimited Swim lesson under the Members tab. What should I expect during a swim lesson? Each 30 minute lesson focuses on fun, safety, and skill progression. At the beginning of each lesson, the instructor will reinforce our ‘Sit, Listen, and Wait’ skill and Air Regulation through blowing bubbles, both key to water safety and strong swimming. The instructor will then go through our expertly crafted curriculum teaching in small groups with a max 4:1 student-to-instructor ratio. How long will it take for my child to learn to swim? Every child learns at their own pace, and that’s completely normal. Our goal is to help your child become a safe, confident, and skilled swimmer — and we support that with a tailored curriculum, expert in-water instructors, and free Unlimited Swim. We focus on what matters most: helping your child learn swimming the right way, at the right pace, for lasting success in the water. What if we can't make a lesson? We offer easy-to-schedule makeup lessons for Baby Swim, Learn To Swim, and Adult Swim programs. If you can’t make a lesson, you can request a Makeup Voucher in your customer portal and you’ll receive a voucher that’s good for up to a year. What age can my child start lessons? We start lessons as early as 3 months old and encourage everyone to start swimming as soon as possible! This helps to ensure water safety and good swimming habits from a young age. How Clean is Your Pool? Very clean! We replace all of our pool water every six days and use an ozone disinfection system—the same type of system used to sanitize bottled water. Our experienced instructors make learning fun while helping kids build proper technique, reach new goals and feel more comfortable in the water. Contact Us Today to Join Our Swim Team Family 541-227-5925 NEXT SUPERIOR AQUATICS TRYOUTS: September 23, 2026 at 3:30pm Oregon Swimming Who We Are Superior Aquatics stands as the premier competitive swim center in Southern Oregon, proudly serving the community since 1992. As a part of the Superior Athletic Club (SAC), our swim team is dedicated to fostering a healthy, enjoyable, and focused training environment for swimmers spanning all age groups. Under the guidance of Coaches Siouxha (ASCA USA & International Level 5 Certification ) and Alexandra Tokman (ASCA USA Level 4 Certification), our team oversees the training programs for four distinct swim groups: Sharks (Pre-Competition), Silvers, Golds, and Elites. This comprehensive structure ensures an ideal setting for swimmers of various ages and skill levels to thrive and reach their full potential. At Superior Aquatics, we are deeply committed to competitive swimming, participating in events across Oregon, California, and Washington. We believe in the process of achieving success. While the realization of achievements is noteworthy, we recognize that the effort invested is equally significant. Encouragement and dedication during training sessions form the cornerstone of unlocking each athlete’s ultimate potential. This combination serves as a powerful tool for growth and development, not only in swimming but also in life itself. Our priority is to create a safe and supportive environment that fosters the growth of every swimmer. Join Superior Aquatics today and become part of a community dedicated to realizing swimming excellence while nurturing personal development. Learn more on the Superior Athletic Club Website. Ready to join Superior Aquatics? Click here ! Our Mission and Vision Statement At Superior Aquatics we are WINNERS! Both in and out of the pool. We aim high by setting ambitious goals and dedicating ourselves to fulfilling our commitments. We believe as a team we can achieve anything. It is our Vision to teach goal setting, respect , having understanding of others by encouraging hard work and by forging on an unbreakable team bond. We provide a safe, healthy and positive environment for athletes of all ages. Meet Our Coaches Learn from the Best! The ONLY ASCA (American Swim Coaches Association) Level 4 and Level 5- USA & International Coaches in Southern Oregon. Siouxha Tokman Siouxha Tokman's association with Superior began in 1994, spanning until 2006, and happily resumed in 2015—an occasion that is commemorated with great enthusiasm. With an illustrious coaching tenure of 53 years, Siouxha holds a distinguished Level 5 ranking certified by the National and International American Swim Coaches Association (ASCA). As one of five ASCA Level 5 Certified Coaches in the state, and the ONLY Level 5 Coach in Southern Oregon, Siouxha's dedication to the craft of coaching is unparalleled. Devoting 5-6 hours daily to coaching athletes ranging from 6 to 20 years old, Siouxha epitomizes unwavering commitment and an authentic passion for his vocation. His steadfast commitment extends beyond honing athletic prowess; he imparts invaluable life skills, including accountability, goal setting, and fostering positive attitudes during moments of pressure. These skills have yielded a track record of success, with numerous student athletes progressing to significant achievements at national and Olympic levels. Siouxha's role as a swim coach is multifaceted, transitioning seamlessly from an entertainer for the younger participants to a trusted mentor akin to an elder sibling for the older swimmers. His infectious smile radiates throughout the club, reflecting the genuine joy he derives from his work. The community is indeed fortunate to benefit from Siouxha's unwavering passion, which significantly contributes to the development of exceptional children and swimmers. Reflecting on his coaching journey, Siouxha shares, "Many ask me why I've given my life to coaching, and my response is, there is nothing more important to me than fostering the character of a young adult into becoming a exemplary human being. To instill passion, perseverance, and a commitment to opportunity and hope in themselves and others are skills that will transform their future and others around them. I've had the privilege of experiencing this transformation for many that I know will lead their generation to greatness. It is an honor, and I am humbled by this path for my life." In Siouxha's own words, being a swim coach is one of the most fulfilling vocations, involving the profound impact of shaping lives and cultivating outstanding individuals within the community. _____ Alexandra Tokman Alexandra Tokman brings six years of competitive swimming experience from her school years, enriching our swim team with her valuable expertise. She held the esteemed position of Age Group Vice Chair on the Oregon Swimming Board of Directors from October 2021-December 2024, Alexandra was elected to this role by her coaching peers. Alexandra is recognized as one of only ten Level 4 ASCA (American Swim Coaches Association) Coaches in the State of Oregon and stands as the ONLY Level 4 Coach in Southern Oregon. As a former student athlete herself, Alexandra intimately understands the challenges and triumphs of pushing through adversities to reach success. This personal experience informs her coaching approach, enabling her to guide swimmers effectively through their own journeys. When reflecting on her coaching philosophy, Alexandra underscores the invaluable life lessons that swimming imparts, emphasizing the correlation between hard work and results, fostering focus, and performing effectively under pressure. As a coach, she is dedicated to guiding swimmers in understanding the significance of rebounding from failure and achieving success. Her passion for the sport resonates in her joy of witnessing children's confidence flourish both in and out of the pool. For Alexandra, coaching transcends being merely a job; it represents a source of profound fulfillment. She takes pride in serving as a positive role model for her swimmers, offering unwavering support on both good and challenging days. In her view, the opportunity to instill confidence in these young athletes is the most significant gift one can offer. Coach Rob joins Superior Aquatics from the Piedmont Swim Team in the Bay Area of California. As head age group coach Rob led the top age group program on the club. During his time with PST he was integral in helping the club grow exponentially. Membership grew from 80 swimmers to well over 200. He has spent his adult life coaching all across Canada and California. He is a level three American Swim Coach Association age group certified coach as well as a National Coaching Certification Program level three coach and instructor in Canada. Rob and his wife Jean recently retired and moved to Grants Pass in September 2025. Rob hopes to bring a level of passion and experience to Superior Aquatics. “Swimming has given me so much over my career. My goal is to instill that passion and love for swimming that I have. If I coach an eight year old, I want to see that swimmer compete in college at eighteen and then see that same swimmer in th e pool at 80! "I began my journey with Superior Aquatics at the tender age of 5 and continued swimming until I embarked on my college adventure at 18. Siouxha, who took over as my age group coach at 10, later became the head coach. Beyond the pool, he evolved into a mentor and, dare I say, a father figure. Siouxha’s dedication went beyond the ordinary – he conducted goal-setting conferences, helping me chart a course to chase my dream of making Olympic trial cut times. His commitment was evident as he took me to high-level meets, providing exposure and invaluable experience. As a Level 5 coach with the highest credentials possible, Siouxha’s expertise has been instrumental in shaping my swimming career. Even as [I] continue my swimming career at the Division 1 level for Notre Dame, Siouxha remains the most reliable supporter, offering guidance whenever I seek it. Equally crucial to my swimming success is Coach Alexandra, my second mom, who diligently executed Siouxha’s tailored workouts and always prioritized my well-being. Superior Aquatics will forever be my home, shaping not just my swimming career but also fostering invaluable relationships. Grateful beyond words for the incredible journey. Sincerely, Marcus Gentry” Sponsors & Partners Social Feed More... We expect participation in swim meets for all athletes. title: Palm Desert Swim Club Home
text: Palm Desert Swim Club Home Sign in Facebook Twitter Instagram Pinterest Home Team Info Joining PDSC Our Coaches Our Mission & Vision Athlete Code of Conduct Team Suit Policy Board of Directors Bylaws Pool Location/Palm Desert Area Volunteer Engagement & Requirements TEAM EQUIPMENT TIME STANDARDS FOR SWIM MEETS PDSC Programs Junior 1 Junior 2 Junior 3 Junior 4 Senior 1 Senior 2 Senior 3 Senior 4 Events USAS Safe Sport Safe Sport Best Practices Safe Sport Concerns/Reporting Locker Room Monitoring Policy Photography Policy Action Plan to Address Bullying MAAPP Grievance Procedure Policy Electronic Communication Policy Concussion Info Sheet Travel Policy Team Records 2026-2027 Team Registration Southern California Swimming Welcome to Palm Desert Swim Club Palm Desert Swim Club exists to give kids something bigger than laps and lane lines: a safe, inclusive, and genuinely exciting culture where they learn to Swim, Compete & Have Fun . Our focus stays simple and consistent—great coaching, strong character, and a team environment where every swimmer feels seen, supported, and challenged at the right level. Our vision is to build the premier swim program in the Coachella Valley , welcoming children of all ages and abilities while developing athletes who can compete at every level. That means thoughtful progression, clear standards, and a program design that meets swimmers where they are—whether your child is brand new to the sport or hungry to race faster. We believe the “right fit” matters, so we encourage families to explore our philosophy and choose the program that aligns with your values. When that alignment is there, the experience becomes rewarding for the swimmer, the parents, and the entire team. Families join PDSC because we take the full journey seriously: skill development, confidence, discipline, resilience, and friendships that last beyond the season. Our Athlete Code of Conduct reflects what we stand for—respect, sportsmanship, responsibility, and a team-first mindset. We expect swimmers to support teammates, treat coaches and facilities with respect, and bring a strong work ethic to practice and meets. In return, families get a positive, structured environment where kids grow—not just as athletes, but as people. Getting started is straightforward. To schedule a swimmer evaluation, contact Coach Mavi at [email protected] . Bring a proper swimsuit, goggles, and a towel, and we’ll guide your swimmer toward the right program while answering any questions you have. Practices are held at the Palm Desert Aquatic Center (73-751 Magnesia Falls Dr, Palm Desert, CA 92260) —located by the Civic Center Park—an ideal home base for building strong swimmers and an even stronger community. Why Swim at Palm Desert Swim Club Starting swim training early gives kids a huge advantage because swimming is a true “skill sport” — the earlier they learn efficient technique, the more natural it becomes. Unlike many sports where effort alone can carry you for a while, swimming rewards precision: body position, timing, breathing control, kick rhythm, and feel for the water. When kids begin training young, they build these fundamentals before bad habits settle in, and they develop a strong aerobic base in a way that’s safe for growing bodies. That foundation pays off for years, whether they eventually race competitively, play water polo, cross-train for another sport, or simply want to be strong, capable swimmers. In the Coachella Valley, swimming also fits the lifestyle perfectly — it’s a year-round sport in a place built for outdoor activity. With so many sunny days, kids can train consistently, build momentum, and stay active when other sports slow down due to heat or seasonal breaks. Swim training creates a healthy routine, helps kids manage energy and focus, and gives them a positive peer group that values hard work, encouragement, and personal progress. As Palm Desert Swim Club continues to grow, our goal is to be the valley’s best option for families who want a sport that’s challenging, fun, and genuinely healthy — a place where kids can set goals, celebrate improvement, and fall in love with the process of getting better. Welcome to the Bakersfield Aquatics Club. BAC is a non-profit, family-oriented competitive swim team. We are a member of USA swimming, managed by a parent board of directors, located on the Bakersfield College campus in the heart of Bakersfield. William A Wheeler Aquatic Complex provides a beautiful location to offer the highest quality swim programs for swimmers of all ages. The heated two pool facility is a great place to realize and exceed your swimming potential. Our dedicated and experienced coaching staff provide a supportive environment for learning and growing as athletes. If your heart is in the water, we have a place for you. Come check out our hard-working team today! Please contact us at [email protected] to schedule an assessment. Our only prerequisite to join the team is that a swimmer must be able to swim the length of a 25-yard swimming pool within one minute. Our mission is to promote water safety and foster a lifelong love of swimming through top-notch instruction - from swim lessons to national level competition. Our culture at COSA Swimming is not only focused on producing fast swimmers, but ensuring our athletes have fun in a safe envirnment. Swimming is a valuable life skill and a healthy activity. The combination of swimming excellence and a positive, enjoyable experience is essential for producing a lifelong love of the sport. Our coaches are active on deck during practice, interacting with each swimmer to provide personalized feedback about their stroke technique to enhance efficiency in the water. Filming during practices is utilized to give swimmers visual feedback, helping target specific areas for improvement. This hands-on approach ensures each athlete receives guidance to refine their skills and improve performance. COSA Swimming offers: An exceptionally skilled swim staff with an accumulated experience of over 250 years in swimming instruction. We work together to provide optimal guidance to individuals of all ages and skill levels, children to senior citizens, and novice swimmers to elite competitors. Strive to provide a low coach to swimmer ratio for our beginner swimming groups. This is essential for ensuring that each swimmer receives personalized attention as they learn and develop their swimming skills. Beyond swimming instruction we provide social opportunities for swimmers and their families. In the past year we have played laser tag, visited water world and tailgated/attended a USAFA football game. COSA organizes and runs swim meets for Colorado Springs’ swimmers. This is a valuable way to support our athletes and fosters a sense of camaraderie among our team while supporting the broader Colorado swimming community. Are you or someone in your family interested in swimming? COSA swimming is the ideal place to pursue your swimming goals whether you're just starting or aiming for competitive excellence. Contact us today via this form or info@ COSASwimming.com and include your swimmer(s) age and which site you would prefer to learn more and become part of the COSA Swimming family! text: Canon City Piranhas Home Facebook Contact Us Sign in Home Registration News Events Events/Meetings Documents Coaches and Directors Pool Location Safe Sport About us The Canon City Swim Team is seeking anyone between the ages of 6-18, who is interested in joining. If you live in Canon City, Florence, Penrose, Rockvale, or any of the surrounding areas and you LOVE to swim, come join our team. The Canon City Swim Team has been swimming since the 70's. We are a family -centric summer swim club and we participate in the Southern Colorado Aquatics League (SECAL). We practice in the summer months starting at the end of May through the first weekend in August. Swim meets are offered (not mandatory) almost every weekend. Swim meet locations are listed below in the meet schedule. Athletic Requirement: You must be between the ages of 6-18 and capable of swimming 25 meters (unassisted). The CKATS Swim Club is committed to developing the potential of all swimmers through training and competition, from novice to advanced, in an environment that fosters individual excellence while developing a strong, cohesive sense of team. The club promotes swimming as a lifelong sport and seeks to not only develop swimming potential, but also skills for life such as sportsmanship, confidence, and leadership. Active family involvement As a non-profit organization, the Cody CKATS rely heavily on the efforts of volunteers. Commitment, teamwork, and excellence are embraced by our club and applies not just to the athletes but also to the team working behind the scenes to ensure a strong and successful club. Families will be encouraged to be actively involved in the club. The existence of a strong culture of volunteerism is also something that the club promotes to create a positive, successful organization. There are many volunteer roles that are available and the higher the level of family participation from the membership the more successful the club will be. The Board of Directors will work towards establishing the following: Social/fundraising committee Swim meet committee Provision of adequate opportunities for parents to train as an official BENEFITS OF SWIMMING: While winning is nice and setting a record, getting a best time, or making a qualifying time feels good, we hope that our young athletes learn more than, It is great to swim fast. There are many benefits to the sport of swimming: Promotes fitness and teaches a child to strive for physical achievement Swimming cultivates a positive mental attitude and high self-esteem Is an exciting individual and team sport Teaches life lessons of sport and sportsmanship, learning to deal with winning and losing and working with others Is a healthy lifelong activity - Participants may be 1 or 101 years old Motivates participants to strive for self-improvement and teaches goal setting & focus Ckats Team Store Team Registration USA Swimming Registration Upcoming Events Sponsors & Partners Facebook ©2026 SportsEngine, LLC. text: Swim Academy for kids in San Francisco | BGCSF About Us Who We Are Child Safety Staff Leadership Board Leadership Our Programs Academic Support Creative Arts Swim Academy Competitive Sports Job Readiness Character & Leadership Health & Life Skills Behavioral Health Services College Success Summer Camp Join a Club Become a Member Find a Club Attend Camp Parents Teens Get Involved Ways to Give Open Positions Volunteer Opportunities Upcoming Events shop BGCSF Store Camp Store GIVE NOW JOIN Swim Academy SIGN UP NOW Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco is proud to be a USA Swimming Foundation Youth Learn to Swim Grant Recipient Our Swim Academy offers an affordable, high-quality, and safe aquatics experience for children and teens. Located at the Don Fisher Clubhouse, our Swim Academy provides: Learn-to-Swim Classes for All Skill Levels Competitive Swim Team (BGCSF Aquatics Club) Girls Water Polo Recreational Swim In addition to the lifelong health benefits of swimming, our aquatics program opens up new opportunities to youth, including linking them to high school and college acceptance and scholarships, as well as job opportunities in aquatics. Signature Programs Classes and swim team practices are all hosted at the Don Fisher Clubhouse , where we have a beautiful competition-sized swimming pool. Learn-to-Swim Our team of professional swim instructors teach four-week classes to help youth ages to 6 to 18 learn to swim. The program focuses on helping kids and teens progressively build confidence in the water. As with all things in the aquatics program, BGCSF is 100% focused on safety first as youth learn to swim. Learn More BGCSF Aquatics Club Our competitive swim team trains year-round and participates in swim meets across the Bay Area, exposing swimmers to healthy competition and great exercise. The BGCSF Aquatics Club has also helped youth receive scholarships and get accepted to high school and college. Learn More Girls Water Polo Girls Water Polo gives 4th–8th graders a fun introduction to water polo fundamentals and swim skills. Participants should be comfortable treading water for at least 30 seconds. Included free with a Clubhouse membership. Learn More Recreational Swim Recreational swim is an opportunity for youth to have fun and practice new skills in the pool, while being supervised by Red Cross-certified lifeguards. A huge thank you to all of our participants, sponsors, and parents who helped make this event such a success. We’re excited to share that we’ve doubled our swim team participation this season and are looking forward to an amazing summer ahead. Thank you again for your support—Go Porpoises! 🐬 PLPOA Porpoises Swim Team The PLPOA Porpoises is a club swim team that is managed by the PLPOA Recreation Center. Certified coaches are hired for this team. PLPOA members, as well as non-members are allowed to join the team. Swimmers must be 7 – 17 and able to swim a length of the pool. This team practices and travels to meets in the Spring and Summer. Club members pay dues monthly. For more information, contact the Rec Center. Head Coach: Matt Nobles 2026 Team: 52 Kids! title: Prime Swim Academy
text: Prime Swim Academy Prime Swim Academy About Us Programs Safe Sport Events News Dashboard Prime Swim Academy Swim with Confidence Schedule Tryout Swimming Programs Tailored training programs designed to elevate your swimming performance at every level Bronze Learning the basics such as floating, breathing, water safety and basic strokes. Goals Comfort in water Swim 25 yards independently • 1-3 sessions per week • 60-minute sessions • Small group instruction Silver Focusing on stroke development, learning proper technique and lane etiquette. Goals Swim 50 yards with legal technique in all the strokes • 4 sessions per week • 60-minute sessions • Competition preparation Gold Focusing on technique refinement, endurance, building, race skills and introduction to swim meet. Swimmers begin attending local competitions. Goals Legal strokes Flip turn Starts and consistent training habits • 3 sessions per week • 90-minute sessions • Elite competition focus Platinum Focusing on more advanced stroke technique, interval training and goal setting. We are a premier year-round swim program focused on building strong fundamentals in a disciplined, positive environment. We offer programs for swimmers ages 5–14 at convenient locations throughout Irvine, including Cypress Village, Eastwood Village, Great Park Neighborhoods, and Woodbury. To access the full site, you must be logged in. For more information, please email us at speedaquatics@gmail.com or call our office during business hours at (657) 900-2026. We’re happy to answer any questions you may have! Join now Joining is Easy! Getting started with Speed Aquatics is simple. Just follow the steps in our drop-down menu — from scheduling an evaluation to completing registration, everything you need is organized and easy to follow. We’re here to make the process smooth and stress-free! 1. Schedule an Evaluation Before registering, all new swimmers must complete an evaluation to determine the best fit for their age and ability. Evaluations are 3-5 minutes in duration. Swimmers are expected to be able to make it accross a 25yd pool doing freestyle or backstroke. Please note instructors will not be in the pool for evaluation. Book your evaluation here 2. Receive Group Placement After the evaluation, our coaching staff will assign your swimmer to the appropriate training group (Speed 1–5). Placement is based on skill level and age. 3. Visit Our Website to Register Once placed, go to our website and click the Registration tab to sign up for your swimmer’s assigned group. You'll be guided through the process step-by-step. 4. Create Your GoMotion Account During registration, you’ll be prompted to create a GoMotion account. This account allows you to manage billing, swimmer info, and practice schedules. 5. USA Swimming USA Swimming Membership All Speed Aquatics swimmers must have a current USA Swimming membership before participating. USA Swimming provides insurance coverage and ensures all athletes are part of a nationally recognized organization promoting safety and excellence in the sport. You can register or renew your membership directly through the USA Swimming portal. A link is provided during the registration process. CLICK HERE TO GET STARTED 6. Start Training Once registration and USA Swimming membership are complete, your swimmer is ready to start! Bring swim gear and a great attitude. Please have required gear for your group. Schedule an evaluation Program info At Speed Aquatics, we offer a progressive, year-round swim program designed for athletes ages 5–18, from beginners to advanced swimmers. Our structured levels ensure that every athlete builds a strong foundation and grows at their own pace in a positive, disciplined environment. At every level, our goal is to foster a love for swimming while encouraging personal growth, confidence, and team spirit. Evaluations are required before placement to ensure swimmers are in the group that best matches their abilities. Speed 1 Speed 1 Introduction to Swimming Perfect for young beginners. Swimmers learn water safety, body positioning, floating, kicking, and basic strokes in a small group setting. We're excited to help you find the right practice group for your swimmer. Pre-Season Tryouts If you are joining Colorado Blue before the start of the fall 2026 season , we offer two rounds of scheduled tryouts. First Wave Tryouts Location: Aurora Central High School Time: 5:30 pm Dates: Monday, July 13 Wednesday, July 15 Monday, July 20 Wednesday, July 22 Monday, July 27 Wednesday, July 29 Each tryout lasts approximately 30 minutes . Based on the coach's assessment, swimmers may be invited to stay for an additional 30 minutes of practice that evening. Please reserve your tryout spot by completing this form . Second Wave Tryouts A second round of tryouts will be offered during the weeks of August 17 and August 24 . Dates and registration information will be posted on our website as they become available. Mid-Season Tryouts Families interested in joining after the season has begun may attend practice through our mid-season tryout process. Tryout Practices New swimmers are welcome to attend up to two (2) complimentary tryout practices to determine whether Colorado Blue is a good fit. If additional evaluation time is needed, swimmers may attend up to five (5) total practices before making an enrollment decision. Practices beyond the first two complimentary sessions will be charged at our standard drop-in rate. USA Swimming Membership Requirements Swimmers who do not currently have a USA Swimming membership May participate in tryout practices for up to one week . After one week, USA Swimming requires all athletes participating in club practices to obtain a current USA Swimming membership. Swimmers who already have a current USA Swimming membership with another club May attend Colorado Blue practices as a drop-in swimmer for up to two weeks or ten (10) practices , whichever comes first. After that point, swimmers must either register with or transfer to Colorado Blue if they wish to continue training. Next Steps If your swimmer decides to join Colorado Blue, we'll help you complete: Colorado Blue team registration USA Swimming registration or club transfer (if applicable) Practice group placement Parent and swimmer onboarding ﻿ Registration If you have questions about practice groups, training expectations, swim meets, or the tryout process, please don't hesitate to reach out to Coach Luca at Luca@swimmingsimply.com. We're happy to help and look forward to welcoming your family to Colorado Blue! Once you have registered, please do the following: ​ Read our Parent Handbook and the accompanying FAQ Page . This will ensure you know which group you want to sign your swimmer up for! This should take 15-20 minutes. These documents include information about all fees, practices, practice groups, etc. The FAQ document is a quick reference guide for this information! Sign the Parent & Swimmer Responsibilities & Commitment Form . This should take 5-10 minutes Looking for Colorado Blue team gear? Check out our team store on Swim Outlet ! We embrace the core objectives of USA Swimming—Build the Base, Promote the Sport, and Achieve Competitive Success—while fostering a coach-led, student-athlete culture built on hard work, discipline, personal growth, and earned self-confidence. Lobo Performance Track is for strong swimmers with aspirations for collegiate swimming, and Lobo Fitness Track is for kids who want to have fun on a team and love the water. Both tracks have a strong focus on technique, athleticism, fitness, team-building, and fun! Lobo es un equipo de natación principalmente centrado en los jóvenes con opciones para que los adultos naden junto a sus hijos. La Pista de Competición es para nadadores fuertes con aspiraciones de natación universitaria, y la Pista de Salud es para niños que quieren divertirse en equipo y que les guste el agua. Ambas pistas tienen un fuerte enfoque en la técnica, el atletismo, el fitness, la formación de equipos y la diversión. Schedule a Tryout Join Lobo Team calendar Upcoming Meets Performance and Fitness Tracks During their time in Black group, swimmers will choose the Track they want to follow: Our Performance Track is designed to guide our athletes through our leveled-group progression and help athletes matriculate and earn a scholarship to a swimming college. There are specialized outcomes, rewards, and requirements on this Track. Our Fitness Track keeps Lobos active without the pressure to race and perform at the level of a highly-skilled swimmer. This is also the Track for swimmers who may prefer a different sport but choose to swim a limited number of times per week for its profound health, physicality, and psychological benefits. Durante el grupo Black, los nadadores elegirán la pista que quieren seguir: Nuestra Pista de Competición está diseñada para guiar a nuestros atletas a través de nuestra progresión en grupos nivelados y ayudarlos a matricularse y obtener una beca para una escuela de natación. Hay resultados, recompensas y requisitos especializados en esta vía. Nuestra Pista de Salud mantiene a Lobos activos sin la presión de competir y rendir al nivel de un nadador altamente calificado. Esta es también la pista para los que prefieren un deporte diferente pero eligen nadar un número limitado de veces por semana por sus profundos beneficios para la salud, el aspecto físico y psicológico. We believe that athletes thrive in an environment where they feel supported, challenged, and valued for who they are, not just how fast they swim. Every practice, every lesson, and every interaction is shaped by our commitment to Family • Performance • Passion • Excellence . These four pillars guide how we train, how we teach, and how we show up for our swimmers both in and out of the water. Family We create a positive, supportive environment where swimmers and families feel welcomed, encouraged, and celebrated. Performance We focus on technique, efficiency, and smart training — preparing swimmers for long-term success, not just short-term results. Passion We aim to build a lifelong love for swimming by keeping practices engaging, challenging, and fun. Excellence We set high standards, encourage accountability, and help swimmers realize their full potential in and out of the pool. Above all, our goal is to develop young people who are resilient, confident, and excited to chase what’s possible. With strong coaching, smart training, and a whole lot of MAKO pride, we’re here to help every swimmer grow — stroke by stroke. Resources Times/Records Support/Volunteer Team Store USA Swimming Safe Sport Welcome to the Vashon Seals Swim Team The Vashon Seals are Vashon Island's community swim team — a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 1983 and based at the public pool, where lifeguards are always on deck. We offer a year-round program for swimmers ages 5 to 18, with flexible scheduling that fits active island kids and a supportive environment for building a lifelong love of the sport — whether you're just getting started or chasing your best time. Our competitive program is serious at every age, with a pathway through USA Swimming and Pacific Northwest Swimming that lets each swimmer go as far as their drive takes them. Older swimmers can also earn PE credit, community service hours, and a pathway to paid lifeguard certification. Run by an all-volunteer board, we're built by and for the whole Vashon community. Join us. Seals Vision Vashon Seals Swim Team will provide a safe and protected environment for swimmers and families from young beginners to the most advanced competitive athletes. We strive to provide a positive, encouraging and healthy culture by teaching camaraderie, respect and sportsmanship through swimming. We will keep our swimming community aware and informed of our programming and safety guidelines throughout the year. Commitment to Inclusion At Vashon Seals, we are committed to fostering a welcoming, inclusive, and respectful environment for all individuals. We stand in solidarity with our swimmers, families, and communities of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, and backgrounds. Hate and discrimination have no place within our team or community. We strive to create a safe, supportive space where every member is valued and celebrated for who they are. Together, we will continue to build a culture of respect, inclusion, and belonging for everyone. Our comprehensive programs cater to diverse ages and abilities, welcoming participants from Pleasanton, Dublin, Livermore, San Ramon, Danville, Fremont, Milpitas, and neighboring communities. text: Home Home About Register USA Swimming 2026 - 2027 Dues & Groups Meets/Events Collegiate Swimming Contact Us JOIN THE TEAM Home About Register USA Swimming 2026 - 2027 Dues & Groups Meets/Events Collegiate Swimming Contact Us REGISTER FOR TTST HERE Explore Truckee Tahoe Swim Team Welcome to Truckee Tahoe Swim Team Truckee Tahoe Swim Team is a year-round competitive USA Swimming team . We are a 501(c)(3) non-profit club , operated by a board of directors that meets monthly. The team is a member of Sierra Nevada Swimming , the local governing body (LSC) under USA Swimming . We’re proud to train at 6,000 feet elevation , right in the heart of California’s beautiful Sierra Nevada Mountains . 👉 Click here to download and read the 2026–2027 Swim Season Handbook Our Mission Our Mission Our mission is to provide every member — regardless of ability — with the opportunity to grow both socially and athletically, without feeling lost or left behind. Community Access & Athlete Opportunity Tahoe-Truckee Swim Team believes every athlete deserves the opportunity to participate, learn, and grow—regardless of financial circumstances. Our Need-Based Scholarship Program provides financial support to dedicated student-athletes who demonstrate a commitment to swimming, positive character, and personal growth both in and out of the pool. ﻿ Interested in applying? Download the TTST Need-Based Scholarship Application and take the next step toward making competitive swimming more accessible for your family. Coaching All of our coaches are certified members of USA Swimming and have access to the most comprehensive training and certification program for youth swimming coaches in the United States. We offer professional coaching for swimmers at all levels, from Novice to National, covering ages roughly 4 to 18 and a wide range of abilities. Our team proudly supports a diverse group of athletes, from Olympic Trials qualifiers to beginners focusing on basic skill development. We also welcome prospective swimmers to experience our program through free trial days. When a training group reaches capacity, free assessment days may be paused, and a waiting list will be started. We maintain separate waiting lists of up to 70 members for both the development levels and the Pre-Senior to National levels. Swimmers entering our first level of the team must be able to safely swim 25 yards and must pass the facility swim test. TTST Swimmer Progression TTST Practice Schedule Weekday practices are held at the Truckee Community Pool: 📍 10939 Truckee Way, Truckee, CA 96161 Click here to visit the Truckee Aquatics Center webpage. During most of the season (school year schedule), practices run from 3:00 pm to 6:00 pm . 🏊‍♂️ Truckee Tahoe Swim Team — 2026–2027 Season Overview Our first practice of the 2026–2027 season will be Tuesday, September 8, 2026 . The last practice of the season will be in late July 2026 , after which the team takes its annual break during August . During the school year (September–June), practices are held in the afternoon between 3:00pm–6:00pm . When school is out, practices move to the morning for about one month before the August break. TTUSD School Year Practice Schedule (September 8, 2026 – June 2027): Mini-Marlin - Offered in short seasonal sessions Ages: Approximately 5–9 Days: Monday–Thursday Time: 4:50–5:40 PM Frequency: 2 days per week Families should email: or with the two preferred practice days. Days are flexible. This system allows the coaching staff to balance the number of swimmers attending each day. If a requested day becomes too full, coaches will work with families to find another option. LTC 1 Ages: Approximately 5–10 Days: Monday–Thursday Time: 4:50–5:45 PM Frequency: 2 days per week Families should email their two preferred practice days to the coaching staff or registrar. LTC 2 Ages: Approximately 8–12 Days: Monday–Thursday Time: 4:50–5:55 PM Frequency: 2 days per week Families should email their two preferred practice days to the coaching staff or registrar. LTC 3 — Pre-Senior Ages: Approximately ages 8 –12, generally ages 10 - 12 are most common. Days: Monday–Friday Time: 3:30–4:40/5:00 PM Swimmers do not have to attend all five days, but more than two practices per week is strongly recommended . Senior Team Ages: 12+ Days: Monday–Friday Time: 3:00–4:40/5:00 PM Frequency: 5 days per week Senior Team swimmers are expected to attend all five practices each week and communicate with coaches when a practice must be missed. Multi-Sport Ages: 12+ Days: Monday–Thursday Time: Approximately 3:30–4:40 PM Frequency: 2 days per week Families should email the coaching staff or registrar with their two preferred practice days. COMMUNICATION Remind App We use Remind App for swim team members Announcements. Download Remind app from app stores and add class code to sign up. Class code: b43ac83 E-mail Head Coach Cyrus: cyrus@truckeeswim.org The best times for email replies from Cyrus are Monday to Friday from 8 am to 12:00 noon. Set up a meeting to discuss individual progression reports on your swimmer. The best meeting times for Cyrus are from 5 pm to 6 pm on most weekdays when the team is at the pool. Go on leave of absence Ask questions about billing All coaches: coaches@truckeeswim.org Ask general questions about levels, and practice times Board of Directors: ttstbod@truckeeswim.org Apply for scholarships Ask questions about club governance Registration 2026/27 SEASON REGISTRATION IS OPEN (JOIN NOW IN UPPER RIGHT CORNER) * NEW & RETURNING MEMBERS NEED TO REGISTER! TTST News 2025 - 2026 Competition Schedule By Cyrus Crews • July 7, 2025 Truckee Tahoe Swim Team 2025–2026 Annual Meet Schedule (Approximate Dates) ﻿ Welcom Back, 2025 Winter Spring Schedule By Cyrus Crews • January 6, 2025 This is a subtitle for your new post SWIM MEET SCHEDULE & 2025 USA SWIMMING REGISTRATION By Cyrus Crews • September 10, 2024 Hi All, Fall 2024 Truckee Tahoe Swim Team - Marlins swim meet schedule is as follows, and all events are ready for sign up by emailing cyrus@truckeeswim.org. I will be making group entries after the deadlines. If you miss a deadline you can sign up before the meet deadline on your own. Fall 2024: October 18 - 20: King of the Hill. All levels and ages of the team are welcome to email to enter this meet before September 20th. Please send in your day preferences if you plan on coming for part of the meet. This meet location has been changed to the NEW pool in Reno! It is now much closer to Truckee. November 9- 11: Folsom Classic. All age groups with time standards are welcome to enter. Please look at the time standards before deciding to enter. Enter this meet by emailing about King of the Hill before October 22nd. Generally speaking it will be for our swimmers that have competed in at least 3 or more meets. The facility is an outdoor pool in Folsom, CA. November 23-24: Fort Bragg Travel Meet. All levels and ages of the team are welcome to email to enter this meet before October 24th. This is a fun meet to take a road trip and travel to the north coast of California! The pool in the town of Fort Bragg is an indoor pool. The surrounding area is beautiful with great seafood. Accommodations are optional but the team has stayed at the Beach Inn hotel in the past. It is very nice. Coach Cyrus will be staying here this year. www.beachinn.com . Winter 2024 - 2025: January 17 - 19 in Carson City, NV. Sign up by December 19th before holidays. All Levels and Ages January 31st - February 2nd. Woodland, CA Senior Winter Championships for Qualified Senior Team Swimmers. Senior team qualified swimmers. February 7 - 9 in Minden, NV. Sign up as soon as we get back from break before January 9th. All levels and ages. Spring 2025: TBA Please remember that all swimmers need to be USA Swimming registered to practice and swim at meets. If you registered last year you will be valid through the end of December 2024, and you will need to renew for 2025. If you are new to the team you need to register ASAP and it will be valid through 12/31/2025. We utilize 2 racing options. TTST and Sierra Marlins. The choice is yours, but I do suggest more competitive and older swimmers to race for the Marlins as this will offer a chance to meet new swimmers and enter relays at meets we join forces with the Folsom Branch. Suggestions for TTST: Novice - Regional levels of our team. Register as Truckee Tahoe Swim Team and race for TTST: https://omr.usaswimming.org/omr/welcome/F76E407CA50D05 Suggestions for Marlins: Pre-Senior - National levels of our team. Register for USA Swimming and Race for The Marlins: https://omr.usaswimming.org/omr/welcome/1D4F4030BB6E58 Kind Regards, ﻿ Cyrus Crews Head Swim Coach Truckee Tahoe Swim Team - Marlins *Hours: 8am - 12 noon Monday - Friday Head Coach Cyrus: cyrus@truckeeswim.org All coaches: coaches@truckeeswim.org Board of Directors: ttstbod@truckeeswim.org We use Remind App for swim team members Announcements. text: Ukiah Krakens Aquatic Club 0 Skip to Content Home Team News Programs Schedule About Contact Ukiah Krakens Aquatic Club Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu Home Team News Programs Schedule About Contact Ukiah Krakens Aquatic Club Home Team News Programs Schedule About Contact Welcome to our team! We are a community of swimmers, divers, and water polo players passionate about our sports. We are excited to have you join our club! We offer a variety of programs for all levels of swimmers, divers, and water polo players. Whether your child is a beginner or a seasoned athlete, we have something for you. Come join our community and have some fun! We are committed to providing our members with a safe and supportive environment where they can reach their full potential. Notice: while we currently are looking for a new pool to practice in we have had to pause all new memberships. Thank your for your patience while we look for a new home for our team. Explore programs Swimming Swimming is an individual or team racing sport that exercises the whole body and is an excellent way to stay healthy and active Diving Description Diving is an individual sport in which athletes perform acrobatic maneuvers while jumping into water from a springboard Water Polo Water polo is a team sport played in a pool where players work together and build teamwork, coordination, communication skills Explore programs Keep Them Active, Healthy, & Having Fun Info Contact About Instagram Programs Swimming Water Polo Diving Non-competitive Swimming Ukiah Krakens Aquatic Club

McCarthy Center for Public Service and the Common Good Innovation Labs Star Route Farms Our Faculty Grants and Awards Life at USF Activism & Engagement Explore San Francisco The Campus Experience Arts & Culture Athletics Campus Safety Health & Wellness Recreation & Club Sports Student Activities Student Employment Student Support University Ministry Beyond the Hilltop Housing & Dining Student Housing Dining on Campus Career Planning & Preparation Alumni Resources News Events Orientation Koret Health & Recreation Center Indoor Swimming Pool Home … Life at USF The Campus Experience Koret Health & Recreation Center Aquatics Indoor Swimming Pool On This page Pool Information Masters Swimming Swim Lessons Youth Swim Team Lifeguarding Registration & Payments Pool Information Pool average temperature: 81.5° (Range 80°-82°, 79° for swim meets) Lap Swim Lap lanes will be open during all pool hours, although the number of lanes available will vary depending on other programs in progress, (i.e., during all swim lesson programs the shallow lanes will be closed to anyone other than those enrolled in the lessons). The pool will have limited lanes from 4-6 p.m., Monday-Friday due to swim team practices and other activities. Circle swimming is mandatory during crowded times. It is recommended to check our Pool Lane Schedule before each visit to avoid lane closures and events. Children 12 years of age or older, who are competent lap swimmers, may lap swim when accompanied in the pool area by a supervising adult. Shallow Lane There is only ONE shallow lane at the Koret Center pool. This lane is often blocked for swim lessons, trainings, or programs. Please take note if you plan to use this lane. Courses Short Course 25 yards = 1 length 71 lengths = 1 mile Long Course For Summer 2025, we will not be doing long course set-up for the Koret pool. 50 yards = 1 length 35 lengths = 1 mile *Long course set up is NOT Olympic size. The shallow end is open for use, so we have a 50 YARD not 50 meter set up. Masters Swimming USF Masters is a competitive, meet-focused program. We participate in a wide range of pool meets, three regional championships, and numerous open water events each year. With 36 Pacific Championships, USF has a long tradition of competing in meets and open water events, supporting one another, and having fun together. Competition—both individual and relay—strengthens our community, helps keep us motivated, and has been central to the team’s identity since our founding in 1989. ​Team Expectations Attend practices at least 2x per week Compete in our three annual championship meets each year (1, 2, or all 3 days) For 2026, the championship meets are: Pacific Short Course Yards Championship – April 10 - 12, Novato Pacific Long Course Meters Championship – July 17 – 19, Moraga Pacific Short Course Meters Championship – October 2- 4, Walnut Creek *At this time the Masters Swim Team has paused accepting new members as the team is at maximum capacity. If you are interested in joining the team, please complete this waitlist form to be notified when tryouts open again. The tryout includes: Swim continuous 500 yds Swim a 100 free for time (cutoff: 2:00) Swim a 100 of another stroke for time US Masters Swimming (USMS) Annual membership with USMS on the USF club is required before you can participate in practices. All inquiries or questions can be directed to the Aquatics Office: aquatics@usfca.edu USF Masters Team Store Shop premium USF Masters–branded gear , including: Swimsuits, parkas, and bags Hoodies and sweats Polos ¼ zip pullovers *All items are made to order, so please allow approximately 3 weeks from your order date for delivery. Open All Practice Schedule Monday-Friday 6:10-7:20 a.m. 7:20-8:30 a.m. Monday-Thursday 6:00–7:15 p.m. Masters Swimming Fees Try-out Fee: $30/entry Join/enrollment Fee: $195 Senior: $89/month (monthly auto renewal required) Individual: $129/month (monthly auto renewal required) All members must also pay the yearly USMS registration fee . Meet the Coach Head Coach: Chris Wagner Coach Chris, now in his fifth year leading the USF program, has continued the team’s championship tradition, guiding them to six Pacific Championships. Under his leadership, the team has broken more than 300 team records, along with four Pacific records and two national records. He is a Certified Level III U.S. Masters Swimming Coach and regularly leads USMS Stroke Development Clinics. An avid open water swimmer, former triathlete, collegiate swimmer, and Prep All-American, Chris now trains as a fitness swimmer and brings the experience and versatility to support swimmers of all abilities and goals. Assistant Coach: Taylor Davis Coach Taylor brings her genuine passion for swimming and coaching others with her on deck everyday. She grew up swimming competitively in Southern California and although Taylor thought she left competition behind after high school, she’s remained an avid swimmer and coach. Coach Taylor is a Certified Level III US Masters Swim Coach and has trained high school and adult swimmers alike. Currently, if Taylor’s not curating or crafting a challenging workout for her Masters teammates, she’s fixating on her own personal swim goals in the pool and open water. Swim Lessons Group Swim Lessons Koret's Learn to Swim program is back for Summer 2026, open to all community members. Lessons are offered for ages 4-12, split into Preschool (4-6) and School-Aged (7-12) tracks, each with four progressive levels. Classes meet Tuesdays and Thursdays, 4:00-6:00 p.m., in three 30-minute time slots per day. Class sizes are kept small, with a maximum of 4 swimmers per instructor. Summer Sessions Session 1: June 2 - 18 Session 2: June 23 - July 9 Session 3: July 14 - 30 Session 4: August 4 - 20 Swim Lesson Fees $225/ 6 Classes *All inquiries or questions can be directed to: aquatics@usfca.edu Private Swim Lessons Private swim lessons are not currently available. Please see our group lesson offerings above. Youth Swim Team Why Join USF Youth Swimming? USF Youth Swimming is a highly competitive USA Swimming team with the coaching staff and facilities to take your swimmer as far as they can go. With a 50 meter indoor pool in the heart of San Francisco and weight training and dryland rooms on site, the USF/Koret center provides the finest swim training venue in the City. We want your swimmer to be successful at swimming and have a great time doing it! With swimmers at all levels and from all over the City, USF Youth Swimming is a tremendous resource for your family and your swimmer and gives them a place where they can make new friends and compete in swimming together. If you would like to tryout for the swim team , you may do so via USF ActiveNet . You will first need to create an online account for the person who is paying, then you will add your swimmer(s). Our swim teams are currently full but if you would like to be placed on our waiting list please send us an email at aquatics@usfca.edu with your swimmer's age and race times (if applicable). If you have additional questions, please email the Aquatics Office at aquatics@usfca.edu . Open All Mission statement for USF Youth Swimming Develop swimming excellence in a supportive environment through challenging training, team unity and competition Practice Schedule USFYS is comprised of five teams: Green (development team), Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum. Here is the current practice schedule: Team Practice Days Practice Time Green Monday, Wednesday, Friday 5:15–6:00 p.m. Bronze/Silver Monday, Wednesday, Friday Tuesday, Thursday 4:00–5:00 p.m. 4:30–5:30 p.m. Gold/Platinum Monday - Friday Tuesday, Thursday Tuesday, Thursday 4:00–6:00 p.m. 7:00–8:30 a.m. (summer) 6:00–7:30 a.m. (during school year) Weight Training (by invitation) Monday, Wednesday, Friday 3:00–4:00 p.m. Individual Stroke Training (by invitation) Saturday 2:00–4:00 p.m Team Fees $100/month (team is on monthly auto-renewal system) Coaching philosophy statement Through Coach Doug’s leadership, USF Youth Swimming has created a program tailored to San Francisco families. With busy schedules and competing interests, it’s difficult to swim the traditional eleven practices a week. USFYS has shortened practice time and yardage but increased intensity and technical training. For Gold and Platinum team swimmers, there are 5 regular afternoon practices, 2 morning practices and where appropriate, weight training 3 times a week. In addition, there is the opportunity for individual stroke technique training every Saturday. The coaching staff is dedicated to helping swimmers find speed and helping them learn how to compete. Whatever, their swim goal, the USFYS coaching staff has the experience and expertise to help a swimmer achieve it. Meet The Coaches Head Coach, Doug Dawkins Image Coach Doug has been Head Coach for USF Youth Swimming since 2023 and was assistant Head Coach for seven years before that. He is also the Head Coach for Convent & Stuart Hall High School Varsity Swimming. Doug grew up and trained in the Bay Area, then went on to swim NCAA Division I for the University of Texas at Austin. Doug has swum for four different Olympic coaches and distilled his coaching style from over six decades of coaching and training experience. Mr. Dawkins is extremely technical and includes stroke correction in every practice. “I want to help every swimmer go as far as they can go and our team of coaches has the experience and expertise to help them get there.” Coach Doug has a BA in Fine Art and an MBA in Corporate Finance and Investment. Assistant Coach, Dillon Virva Image Coach Dillon has been coaching USF and Convent & Stuart Hall High School since 2023. He is a former U.S. National Swimming Team member and finaled in the 2016 U.S. Olympic Trials. Dillon swam NCAA Division I for University of Nevada Las Vegas and is a multiple winner in the Western Athletic Conference Championships as well as WAC Swimmer of the Year for 2015. Dillon brings top-level competitive experience to the USFYS team and particular knowledge as a sprint freestyle and butterfly specialist. Coach Dillon has a BA in Earth & Environmental Science. Assistant Coach, Grace Baker Image Coach Grace has been a USFYS coach since 2024. Her aquatic background spans over twenty years of competitive year-round swimming and over a decade of specialized coaching. From 2015–2017 she coached a local year-round competitive youth team, focusing on stroke mechanics, self-motivation, and teamwork. While simultaneously coaching US Masters Swimming and the Gold Country Triathlon Club, incorporating video analysis and stroke instruction for peak performance. Grace swam NCAA Division III for Lewis & Clark College, then transferred to UCLA to graduate in 2020 with a degree in Sports Psychology. Grace runs all of the USFYS morning practices and coaches the Gold & Platinum groups in the afternoons. “I encourage our swimmers to set both short and long-term goals, build smart training plans, and celebrate their own and their teammates' wins.” Assistant Coach, Nate Gallagher Image Coach Nate has coached swimming since 2023. He has been the Aquatics Manager for Menlo Park, and the pre-team coach for the JCC before coming to USF Youth Swimming. Nate is also a Masters swimmer and has a strong interest in stroke mechanics. Nate is mainly responsible for Green, Bronze and Silver teams and focuses on preparing swimmers for competition and moving to the next level in the club. “I want all of our swimmers to have a great experience and enjoy swimming. I want them to have fun while they are learning to compete.” Coach Nate has a BA in Philosophy from the University of Colorado, Boulder. Lifeguarding If you are interested in applying to the lifeguard position at Koret and have a current lifeguard certification, please send us an email at aquatics@usfca.edu and attach your resume and current lifeguard certification. We will follow up with you by scheduling a lifeguard tryout. Our lifeguard tryout is roughly 30-minutes long and includes a swim-tread-swim sequence (i.e. 150 yards freestyle or breaststroke, two minute tread with no hands, and 50 yards freestyle or breaststroke) followed by a timed event (i.e. retrieving a 10 lb brick at a depth of 7-10 ft) and a demonstration of rescues and CPR skills. If you are interested in becoming a lifeguard and do not have a current lifeguard certification, we offer Lifeguard Classes on-site. Our Lifeguard Classes follow the Red Cross certification program and include CPR, First Aid, and Lifeguarding certificates upon successful completion. Please note that you must attend all days of our Lifeguard Class to complete the course. The Lifeguard Class is typically 3-4 days long. We will be offering our next Lifeguard Class in the Spring Semester (exact times/dates TBD). If you are interested, please email aquatics@usfca.edu and we will add you to our notification list for whenever we have it scheduled. Open All Requirements for Lifeguard Class Must be 15 years of age and be able to pass the pre-course swimming test on the first day of class This includes a 300-yard swim using front crawl or breaststroke, a 2-minute tread using legs only, and the ability to retrieve a 10-lb dive weight (a brick) from 7 ft deep, surface and swim 20 yds with the weight, using legs only and exit the pool without using a ladder within 100 seconds. Registration & Payments Registration sign-ups and enrollment information for all Aquatics programs will be handled online. You will need to create an account on ActiveNet . Book an Appointment Online Adult & Youth Private Swim Lessons Learn more and view our detailed instructions for booking private lessons. Our facility does not accept pre-booked lessons. Please do not put in payment details without having selected dates/times first for your swim lessons. All private lesson bookings must be made through our online system. Patrons who are having difficulty booking online, are invited to contact aquatics@usfca.edu for assistance. Program Refunds Program refunds are available only if requested a minimum of 7 days prior to the start of the program. Fees are not pro-rated and there are no make-up sessions. A complete list of registration policies for Aquatics programs is available upon request. View the cancellation policy for more information. ABOUT US WEST Coast Aquatics is a 501-3c Non-Profit Organization aimed at providing world class swimming instruction. Our facility is owned and operated by our USA Swimming Club Team. We are more than a swim team, we are an aquatic community. We believe in swimming for life and have programs for people of all ages, including year-round club team, recreation swim teams, swim lessons and many additional programs. Despite our small club team size, WEST regularly finishes in the top-10 of Pacific Northwest Swimming. West athletes have attended US Olympic Trials, National Championships, Select Camps and many have graduated to attend top NCAA Division I, II and III programs. We are proud of our rich history in Pacific Northwest Swimming but more importantly we are proud of the people our swimmers grow to become and the life skills they take with them from our sport. The Missoula YMCA Swim Team (MYST) is a competitive swim program for Western Montana youth. Led by nationally recognized Head Coach Kirby Beierle, MYST has sent countless swimmers on to swim at the collegiate level. We also offer a pre-competitive program. Cost: $107/month w/ YMCA Household, Family, or 2-Person membership $121/month w/ YMCA Youth membership Meet Head Coach Beierle My swim philosophy focuses on developing swimmers physically, mentally, and emotionally while embracing the YMCA's core values of Caring, Honesty, Respect, and Responsibility. — Coach Kirby Who We Are Previous Next Missoula YMCA Swim Team FAQs Where does the Missoula YMCA Swim Team (MYST) practice? During the short-course season (September–May), the Missoula YMCA Swim Team practices in the YMCA's 25-yard indoor pool. During the long-course season (June–August), the team practices at Splash Montana's 50-meter outdoor pool. We also host dryland workouts. These workouts are held upstairs in the YMCA's Health & Wellness Center. Does my swimmer need to be a YMCA member to join the Missoula YMCA Swim Team? Depends. YMCA of the USA requires all competitive youth swimmers hold active YMCA memberships. Membership discounts are available for youth swimming for the Missoula YMCA Swim Team. Swimmers in our pre-competitive program accepts both YMCA members and non-members. Discounts for the pre-competitive program are available for swimmers with YMCA Household, Family, or 2-Person members. What experience is required for swimmers to join the team? No previous competitive experience is required to join the Missoula YMCA Swim Team. However, swimmers must be able to swim a full length of backstroke (25 yards) and a full length of front stroke (25 yards) in the Missoula YMCA's pool. Do you offer a pre-competitive or a non-competitive swim team option? Yes. Our pre-competitive swim team is for swimmers ages 5+. Swimmers will work with coaches to improve technique and endurance. Practices are 45 minutes and held once a week. The pre-competitive team meets September–May.
